page_description: Hand your AI provider's API key to SayOVA on your watch, encrypted end to end.
tagline: Talk to AI from your wrist
missing_text: Open SayOVA on your watch and pick your provider on the {provider} screen. Then scan the QR code it shows with your phone's camera, or tap {phone}.
missing_note: This page only works with a code from your watch.
expired_reason_timeout: This code has expired. Codes are valid for ten minutes.
expired_reason_used: This code has already been used.
expired_note: Go back to your watch and start the connection again to get a fresh code.
form_intro: SayOVA talks to the AI provider with your own API key, so you stay in control of cost and data.
help_summary: How do I get a key?
help_gemini_1: Sign in to Google AI Studio and open {menu}.
help_gemini_3: In the EU, the UK and Switzerland, turn on billing: {menu}. Prepay with $5 lasts for many hours of talking, and on the paid tier Google does not use your conversations to improve its products.
help_openai_1: Sign in to the OpenAI platform and open {menu}.
help_openai_3: Make sure your account has credit under {menu}.
privacy: Your key is encrypted in this browser for your watch alone. Our server only passes on data it cannot read and deletes it within ten minutes.
sent_text: Your watch now shows a code. If it is the same, tap the check mark {matches} there:
sent_received: Your watch received the key. Confirm the code there – then you can close this page.
sent_timeout: The watch did not pick up the key in time. Start again on your watch.
error_key_incomplete: That does not look like a complete API key. Copy it again from your provider.
error_send_expired: This code has expired. Start again on your watch.
error_send_used: This code has already been used. Start again on your watch.
share_page_description: A conversation sent from SayOVA on your watch.
share_missing_text: On your watch, open a conversation in SayOVA's history and tap {send}.
share_note: The text stays on this phone: it is only in this page's address, which is never sent to a server.
event_hint: Your calendar app takes the event: if the phone asks, open the downloaded file with it.
event_note: The event stays on this phone: it is only in this page's address, which is never sent to a server.
